title: Whether each bucket grants access to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers

items.description: One entry per bucket examined. A bucket whose bucket resource could not be read has an error scoped to its name and no entry

publicGrant.description: true: the IAM policy, an ACL or the default object ACL names allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers. false: neither does. null: the IAM policy could not be read (an error scoped to the bucket says why) and no ACL grants it

publicViaIam.description: The IAM policy has a public binding; null when the policy could not be read

publicViaAcl.description: A legacy bucket ACL entry is public. Always false with uniform bucket-level access, where ACLs do not apply

publicViaDefaultObjectAcl.description: The default object ACL (the ACL new objects start with) names a public entity. Always false with uniform bucket-level access

publicAccessPrevention.description: enforced or inherited; null when not reported

blockedByPrevention.description: There is a public grant and public access prevention is enforced, which makes the grant ineffective

iamBindings.description: The IAM bindings that name a public member, at most 50

conditional.description: The binding has an IAM condition: it holds only while the condition does

aclEntries.description: The legacy bucket ACL entries that name a public entity, at most 50

defaultObjectAclEntries.description: The default object ACL entries that name a public entity, at most 50

omitted.description: Buckets left out of the run by maxItems
